Messages.Author: PeterM
Messages.Body:
I'm organizing my first tournament and I was wondering.
If I give a set of criteria to LSJ for sanctioning (ie #of rounds,
judges, time limits), can I change those criteria IF I tell everyone
before they begin play, and I document it? Can I change _some_ of
those criteria?

Thanks

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


You can if you advertise the change well in advance.
